# Isolde Duckett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Isolde Duckett features bright, black eyes and rosy cheeks. Her face is also characterized by enchanting dimples.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## History

Isolde Duckett was married at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill), with her friend [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) helping her prepare for the ceremony on her wedding day. Over four years into her marriage, she visited the attic at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to chat with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about Nell's upcoming marriage to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), the local gossips of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), and Isolde's young daughter, [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), +2 more_

## Quotes

> "My new home won't be distant. Our affection for one another will remain just as strong. That friendship ‘oath’ we pledged so many years ago has never been broken by us, has it?"
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003)

> "Hold on until it is your turn, Miss Nell. Oh, Nell, my ear catches father walking up the stairs. Hand me my bouquet. Is my veil positioned correctly? Do I look extremely pale?"
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P9](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0009)

> "Naturally, there are ups and downs in married life. Expecting all things to proceed smoothly all the time is a mistake. However, Nell, I can give you my assurance that life is happy, provided your husband is the right man."
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)

> "Being so tall and slight, you will resemble a complete queen wearing it. Nell, in what manner DO you remain so thin? My weight has increased even more—before long, my waist will completely disappear."
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025)

> "Oh, Nell—I am terribly anxious—I am unable to carry on—Nell, I am certain that I shall lose consciousness."
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P7](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0007)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/isolde-duckett--nell-harcourt.md)

Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a close friendship, with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) helping Isolde dress and prepare for her wedding day at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). They later catch up in the attic at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to chat about Nell's upcoming marriage to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), her impending move to [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor), and their shared past in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). During their conversations, they also reflect on Isolde's young daughter, [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), +8 more_

- Friend of — close friends exchanging affection before a wedding  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 ch.Wedding P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010), +1 more</sub>
